subject.title: googlechat: deliver media as a text link when attachment upload is unauthorized (app auth)

question: Should maintainers continue with this contributor branch as the canonical Google Chat app-auth media fallback candidate, or route the work to the overlapping member PR after refresh?
rationale: Two open PRs target the same canonical issue, this branch is dirty and still has code/proof blockers, and automation cannot choose the permanent canonical branch or waive real Google Chat proof.

options.title: Repair this branch before merge
options.body: Keep this PR open and require the narrower upload-scope predicate, metadata preservation, conflict refresh, and inspectable app-auth proof before final review.

options.title: Switch to the member candidate
options.body: Pause or close this PR only if https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89906 becomes mergeable, proof-accepted, and covers the same three delivery paths.

options.title: Waive proof deliberately
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept source-level proof, but the predicate, metadata, and conflict blockers still need repair before merge.

recommendation.title: Repair this branch before merge
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open and require the narrower upload-scope predicate, metadata preservation, conflict refresh, and inspectable app-auth proof before final review.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Google Chat media/action/outbound history makes this the strongest available routing signal for the canonical-fix choice.
